描述_EN: the remainder of the ground is embroidered with an all-over swastika fret pattern in blue, and coloured clouds. the animal is set on a rock above waves and water. the square has a key-fret border entirely in couched gold thread. the blue silk gauze ground is embroidered with coloured silks in tent stitches and couched gold thread. rank badge from the front of a robe or surcoat (the square is divided) showing a qilin, the badge of a military official of the 1st rank. the qilin is almost entirely in couched gold thread.
描述_ZN: 地面的其余部分绣有蓝色的卍字纹和彩色的云纹。 该动物被放置在水波之上的岩石上。 广场上有一个完全用金线编织的钥匙花边。 蓝色丝质地面上绣有彩色丝线的帐篷针和耦合金线。 长袍或大衣前面的等级徽章（方形被分割），显示麒麟，是一级军事官员的徽章。 这只麒麟几乎完全是用金线绣的。
